Northern Tulcea afternoon RO-Alert lifted without reported Romanian airspace entry

24 November 2026 · Northern Tulcea · afternoon RO-Alert

Selected RO-Alert; no entry into Romanian airspace reported

Romania warned northern Tulcea again on 24 November after a target was detected near the Chilia branch in Ukrainian airspace. No Romanian airspace entry was reported.

The Defence Ministry reported a 14:37 EET warning, aircraft monitoring and a 15:40 all-clear for northern Tulcea. ProTV reports Galați’s air-alert phase began at 14:52 EET after a report of an unidentified drone heading toward the county. The local IGSU all-clear was reported at 15:46 EET.

Target identity, operator and intended target are unknown. It is not established whether the Tulcea and Galați warnings concerned the same target. The morning warning remains separate.

This is a precautionary alert, not a confirmed Romanian incursion.
